candidates.reason: Offline Rapier (@dimforge/rapier3d-compat) created 22 spherical impulse joints across 23 proxy rigid bodies named for the MPFB2 core. Proxies move under gravity and stay constrained (connected mean parent-child sep 0.07 m). No writeback maps physics state onto the 137-bone skinned armature — skinnedArmatureBonesDriven=0, subject GLB animations unchanged. Proxy simulation ≠ driving the MPFB rig. First actor-ragdoll attempt here; #457/#489 were placement rejects only.

decision.summary: Only BVH retarget with the MPFB2 default_no_toes map moves the skinned MPFB rig (22/137 bones). Mesh2Motion cannot bind (0/53 map, no CLI). Rapier ragdoll proxies do not write the armature. Do not adopt any candidate as the factory motion default; continue the partial BVH/MPFB2 path and expand the map if fuller coverage is required.
